rationale: The assistant correctly identified the heater element or thermal cut-out as likely causes, used the interrupted-cycle clue, and escalated to an engineer once the customer had no meter and could not identify the parts. It did not bypass safety devices or name a part number. Weaknesses: it offered the control board as a possibility and never asked for the exact model. It also said the interruption 'suggests something may have overheated' and that the button 'is likely the thermal cut-out', which are slightly speculative. It did not mention that the cut-out may be one-shot or that airflow should be rechecked if the fault recurs.
